title: Early Career Fellowships
about: Leverhulme Trust Early Career Fellowships, tenable for 36 months at a UK host university. The 2027 round opens on 1 January 2027; fellowships must start between 1 September 2027 and 1 May 2028.
requirements: Doctoral thesis submitted for viva voce examination not more than four years before the closing date
Applications are submitted through the host university

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "All research disciplines" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Doctoral thesis submitted for viva voce examination not more than four years before the closing date" → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
